parameters.name: engine_version

cluster: Cluster Edition.

Finance：三节点企业系列
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:

general_essd：高性能云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL

该参数仅适用于RDS MySQL

The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID.

For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, if you specify an instance ID, only minor versions later than the current minor version of the instance are returned

实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。

对于RDS PostgreSQL实例，输入实例ID时，仅查询高于该实例当前小版本的所有小版本信息

MaxRecordsPerPage.description_en: The number of records per page

MinorVersionItems.description_en: The list of minor engine versions

items.description_en: The details of the minor engine version

CommunityMinorVersion.description_en: The community minor version that corresponds to the minor engine version
CommunityMinorVersion.description_zh: 内核小版本对应的社区小版本

Engine.description_en: The database engine that corresponds to the minor version
Engine.description_zh: 小版本对应的数据库引擎

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version that corresponds to the minor version
EngineVersion.description_zh: 小版本对应的数据库版本

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time of the minor engine version

ExpireStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the minor engine version. Valid values:

vaild: Milvus version is valid.
expired: Milvus version has expired.

If the offline status is Offline, Milvus version has been taken offline and the expiration status is ignored. If the offline status is Online and the expiration status is expired, Milvus version has exceeded its lifecycle. If the offline status is Online and the expiration status is vaild, Milvus version is still within its lifecycle
ExpireStatus.description_zh:
内核版本过期状态。返回值如下：

vaild：有效
expired：过期

下线状态为Offline时，表示版本已下线，此时忽略过期状态。下线状态为Online时，过期状态为expired，表示版本已超过生命周期；过期状态为vaild，表示版本仍在生命周期内
ExpireStatus.title_en: 内核版本过期状态：vaild-有效；expired-过期
ExpireStatus.title_zh: 内核版本过期状态：vaild-有效；expired-过期

IsHotfixVersion.description_en: An internal parameter. You can ignore this parameter

MinorVersion.description_en: The version number of the minor engine version

NodeType.description_en:
The instance edition that corresponds to the minor version. Valid values:
Basic: Basic Edition.
HighAvailability: high-availability series.
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
NodeType.description_zh:
小版本对应的实例系列。返回值：
Basic：基础系列。
HighAvailability：高可用系列。
Finance：三节点企业系列

ReleaseNote.description_en: The URL of the release notes for the minor version

ReleaseType.description_en:
The release type. Valid values:
LTS: Long-term support version.
BETA: Preview version
ReleaseType.description_zh:
发布类型。返回值：
LTS：长期支持版本。
BETA：预览版本

StatusDesc.description_en:
The offline status of the minor engine version. Valid values:
Offline: Milvus version has been taken offline.
Online: Milvus version is online.

If the offline status is Offline, Milvus version has been taken offline and the expiration status is ignored. If the offline status is Online and the expiration status is expired, Milvus version has exceeded its lifecycle. If the offline status is Online and the expiration status is vaild, Milvus version is still within its lifecycle
StatusDesc.description_zh:
内核版本下线状态。返回值如下：
Offline：下线
Online：在线

下线状态为Offline时，表示版本已下线，此时忽略过期状态。下线状态为Online时，过期状态为expired，表示版本已超过生命周期；过期状态为vaild，表示版本仍在生命周期内
StatusDesc.title_en: 内核版本下线状态：offline-下线
StatusDesc.title_zh: 内核版本下线状态：offline-下线

Tag.description_en:
The tag that corresponds to the minor engine version. Valid values:

pgsql_docker_image: general instance tag.
pgsql_babelfish_image: Babelfish instance tag.

This value is returned only for PostgreSQL
Tag.description_zh:
内核小版本对应的标签。返回值如下：

pgsql_docker_image：通用实例标签。
pgsql_babelfish_image：Babelfish实例标签。

当前仅PostgreSQL返回该值
